chat.welcomeMessage: Ask me to do anything with your {{host}} {{noun}}. I'll write and run office.js code to make it happen.
chat.exampleOutlook: Try: "Summarise this email" or "Draft a reply"
chat.exampleWord: Try: "Make all headings blue" or "Insert a 3-column table"
chat.exampleExcel: Try: "Put 1 through 10 in column A" or "Make a chart from B2:D8"
chat.examplePowerpoint: Try: "Add a slide titled 'Q3 plan' with three bullets" or "Make all slide titles bold"

tighten.title: Tighten
tighten.hint: Select paragraphs in the document, then click Tighten selection. Nothing changes until you click Accept.
tighten.skipSpecialCharacters: contains line breaks, tabs or special characters
tighten.skipMixedFormatting: has mixed formatting, such as one bold word
tighten.rejected: Rejected. The document was not changed.
tighten.documentChanged: The selection or its text changed after the preview, so nothing was written. Run Tighten again.
tighten.undone: Undone. The original text is back.
tighten.undoRefused: Couldn't undo safely because the selection or its text changed. Use Ctrl+Z in Word instead.
tighten.nothingToTighten: Nothing to tighten: the selected paragraphs are empty or were skipped.
tighten.badFormatTitle: The model's reply wasn't in the expected format
tighten.cutOffTitle: The model's reply was cut off
tighten.cutOffDetail: Nothing was changed. Select fewer paragraphs and try again.
tighten.partialWriteHint: Some paragraphs may already have changed; use Ctrl+Z in Word to restore them.
